info.title: API-DocTest-List Hotel Loyalty Points Tiers-v1-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Tiers API enables users to access detailed information about various loyalty points tiers offered by hotels. This endpoint provides insights into the benefits and requirements associated with each tier, allowing consumers to better understand their loyalty program options. Typical users include hotel guests and loyalty program managers who need to analyze tier structures for enhanced customer engagement and marketing strategies. Through this API, developers can integrate tier information into applications, facilitating informed decision-making for travelers and enhancing user experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access their current loyalty tier points, which indicates their status and rewards in the loyalty program. The response includes details about the tier level, thresholds, and any associated benefits.
